slug: 2026-01-14 Guinea Reviews 2025 Digital Sector Gains, Targets Faster Rollout in 2026

facts.fact: The minister's 2025 sector review, as reported by WeAreTech Africa, says nearly 12,000 km of fibre optic was deployed to connect all administrative regions; as_of is the 2025 review year, the article is dated 2026-01-14.
The same review says national backbone capacity quadrupled to 200 Gbps from 50 Gbps in 2025, per the Minister of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy.
